mission.objective: Find the root cause of an intermittent crash
mission.title: Daemon dies under load, cause unknown
mission.task: The scheduler daemon crashes roughly once every few hours under sustained load with no consistent stack trace — sometimes it's a segfault-shaped exit, sometimes an unhandled rejection with no message. We don't know yet whether this is a leak, a race in the worker pool, or a native binding issue. Root-cause it before proposing a fix.
